entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to process a return for a pair of cycling shoes I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF886753.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order pulled up now. I see the Urban Pro cycling shoes. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried them on a few rides, and no matter how I adjust the cleats, they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've checked our policy. It looks like your purchase was delivered 38 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard gear. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I had to go through the trouble of testing them out and getting these blisters, and now have to repackage them and send them back, is there anything you can do for me? Maybe a discount on a future order? I still need a good pair of shoes.

I understand completely. Let me see... I see here that you're a VIP member with us, Alex, and we definitely want to make this right. For the inconvenience, I can absolutely issue you a 15% discount code that you can apply to your next VeloFit order. How does that sound?
A 15% discount works perfectly. That's a fair solution. Thank you, David.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed you the prepaid return label for the cycling shoes and that discount code. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
